name: smwgraphics-super-mario-world-styled-super-bell
title: Super Mario World Styled Super Bell
description:
A Super Mario World styled Super Bell (from Super Mario 3D World) power-up GFX.

It uses Palette A, and it comes with the "GFX00.bin" which replaces the cape power-up, and a "ExGFXA0.bin" which has the standalone GFX for use with LX5's Custom Power-Up patch if you want to use it with the cat suit (though you might have to move it around if you got other power-ups you're using with that too).
